$comment: Target range, 110 m from spawn. Contract: docs/GDD.md 'Static colliders'. Local frame: +x east, +y up as height ABOVE the terrain surface, +z north; lane runs along +x; yaw in degrees about +y, 0 = facing +z. SITE CHOICE IS LOAD-BEARING: flatten_radius 32 + flatten_falloff 12 levels terrain out to 44 m, so the origin must clear both the spawn disc and every landmark by more than that. The first placement was 60 m from spawn on a bearing that put it 8 m from the 'beacon' landmark -- it flattened the landmark away (t9 read 154 m against an expected 165 m) and its falloff band tilted the spawn disc to 2.59 m against a 0.5 m tolerance. This site is 110 m from spawn and 161 m from the nearest landmark.

colliders.$note: cover post - the sphere collider path

$props_comment: Range dressing, kept deliberately thin: this is a firing line and anything between the shooter and the targets is something to shoot by accident. Props are visual only and have no collider.
